# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 1 token; Text — 1 token; Borders and rings — 4 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 27 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 9 tokens; Radius — 9 tokens; Shadow — 6 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css */
color: var(--background);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `background` | #ffffff | #0a0a0a | Content area, cards, dialogs, popovers, plain toasts. |

## Color · Borders and rings

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css */
color: var(--border);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `border` | #e5e5e5 | #ffffff1a | Dividers inside panels, and the outlines of cards, dialogs and popovers (shadcn --border). |
| `outline` | #0a0a0a0d | #ffffff0d | The faint edge of a panel over the window material: the foreground at 5%, lighter than border. |
| `ring` | #a1a1a1 | #737373 | Keyboard focus ring at 50% opacity, and a hovered or dragged divider (shadcn --ring). |

**Interaction states** (same roles, suffixed):

| token | light | dark |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `divider-hover` | #d4d4d4 | #404040 |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css */
color: var(--muted);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (27)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `muted` | #737373 | #a1a1a1 | Secondary text, icons at rest, timestamps, counts. |
| `window` | #ededed | #1e1e1e | Top bar and icon rail behind the panel (transparent over the window material on macOS and Windows 11). |
| `sidebar` | #fafafa | #171717 | Page sidebars (mail folders, settings, Wit conversations); light fills of cards inside panels and kbd. |
| `input` | #e5e5e5 | #ffffff26 | Outlines of inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios, the switch track and outline buttons (shadcn --input). |
| `primary` | #171717 | #e5e5e5 | Default buttons, a switch that is on, checked boxes. |
| `primary-text` | #ffffff | #171717 | Text and icons on primary. |
| `hover` | #f5f5f5 | #262626 | A hovered row, ghost button or secondary button; badges; tab list track. |
| `sidebar-selected` | #f5f5f5 | #262626 | The selected row of a sidebar, at regular weight; its icon is muted until hovered. |
| `rail-selected` | #0a0a0a0a | #ffffff1a | The selected icon of the rail: a tint of the foreground over the window material (4%; dark: white 10%). |
| `hover-tint` | #0a0a0a0a | #ffffff14 | A hovered rail icon or ghost button: a tint of the foreground over the window material (4%; dark: white 8%); over white it equals hover. |
| `unread` | #2b7fff | #2b7fff | The dot beside unread mail in the list. |
| `success` | #00a63e | #00a63e | Status dot for a healthy account; success icons. |

| `success-text` | #008236 | #008236 | Success toast text and icon. |
| `attention` | #fd9a00 | #fd9a00 | Status dot asking for a look (re-login needed). |
| `warning-bg` | #fffbeb | #fffbeb | Warning toast and alert background. |
| `warning-border` | #ffd230 | #ffd230 | Warning toast and alert outline. |
| `warning-text` | #973c00 | #973c00 | Warning toast and alert text and icon. |
| `danger` | #e7000b | #e7000b | Destructive actions, error text, invalid input outline. |
| `danger-bg` | #fef2f2 | #fef2f2 | Danger alert and error toast background; a destructive ghost button on hover. |
| `danger-border` | #ffc9c9 | #ffc9c9 | Error toast outline. |
| `danger-text` | #c10007 | #c10007 | Error toast text and icon. |
| `ins-bg` | #dcfce7 | #dcfce7 | Inserted words in a Wit revision. |
| `ins-text` | #016630 | #016630 | Text of inserted words. |
| `del-bg` | #fef2f2 | #fef2f2 | Deleted words in a Wit revision. |

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-xs);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `xs` | `.xs`, `--text-xs` | 11px / 1.4 | 400 | `sans` |  |
| `sm` | `.sm`, `--text-sm` | 12px / 1.45 | 400 | `sans` |  |
| `base` | `.base`, `--text-base` | 13px / 1.5 | 400 | `sans` |  |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 14px / 1.6 | 400 | `sans` |  |
| `lg` | `.lg`, `--text-lg` | 15px / 1.5 | 500 | `sans` |  |
| `title` | `.title`, `--text-title` | 16px / 1.4 | 600 | `sans` |  |
| `xl` | `.xl`, `--text-xl` | 18px / 1.35 | 600 | `sans` |  |
| `2xl` | `.\32 xl`, `--text-\32 xl` | 20px / 1.3 | 600 | `sans` |  |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 29px / 1.25 | 600 | `sans` |  |
| `mono` | `.mono`, `--text-mono` | 12px / 1.5 | 500 | `mono` |  |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `Geist, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
padding: var(--space-0-5);
```

### Tokens (9)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `space-0-5` | 2px | Gap between sidebar rows. |
| `space-1` | 4px | Tight gaps; the base unit (Space(n) = 4n). |
| `space-1-5` | 6px | Icon-to-label gap in small controls. |
| `space-2` | 8px | Panel inset from the window edge; row padding. |
| `space-2-5` | 10px | Card and list-row padding. |
| `space-3` | 12px | Sidebar padding; card gap. |
| `space-4` | 16px | Page padding on small panes; dialog gaps. |
| `space-6` | 24px | Page content padding; dialog padding. |
| `space-8` | 32px | Row and control height (default button). |

## Shadow

### Use

```css
/* var(--shadow-xs) */
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `shadow-xs` | 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05) | Inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios, outline buttons, the page panel (Tailwind v4 shadow-xs). |
| `shadow-sm` | 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1) | Cards, the selected tab (Tailwind v4 shadow-sm). |
| `shadow-md` | 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1) | Popovers, select lists (Tailwind v4 shadow-md). |
| `shadow-lg` | 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.1) | Dialogs, sheets, toasts (Tailwind v4 shadow-lg). |
| `shadow-xl` | 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1) | Anything above dialogs (Tailwind v4 shadow-xl). |
| `shadow-float` | 0 0 0 1px #0000000a, 0 2px 8px 0 #0000000a, 0 4px 80px 8px #00000006 | A floating input box (the Wit input): the 1px ring is its outline, so it has no border. Dark: rgba(255,255,255,0.2) 0 0 1px 0 inset; the app draws that as a white 12% hairline, as mygo has no inset shadow. |
